description: Unit test class for the DeleteAttribute command in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.modify package. It tests creation, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality of DeleteAttribute instances.

classes.name: DeleteAttribute
classes.description: Represents a command to delete an attribute from a thing, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the DeleteAttribute class is immutable, along with related classes.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for DeleteAttribute.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullJsonPointers
methods.description: Tests that creating an instance with null JSON pointers throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidArguments
methods.description: Tests the successful creation of a DeleteAttribute instance with valid arguments.

methods.name: createInstanceWithInvalidArguments
methods.description: Tests that providing invalid JSON pointers results in a JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Tests that using an empty JSON pointer throws AttributePointerInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of a DeleteAttribute instance from JSON.
